task: Finance::rate breaks when the true rate is zero or the solver starts from a zero guess. rate(10, -100, 1000, 0, false, 0.0) throws DivisionByZeroError instead of returning (very nearly) 0, for payments at the beginning of the period as well as the end, and rate(12, -100, 1200, 0) returns NAN instead of a rate within 1e-6 of 0. A zero initial guess must also still find nonzero rates, positive and negative, and the existing rate results must not change.
notes: Finance::rate tolerance work; the 2026-11-15/16 Pair runs worked on its neighbours.
